title: Marius the Roman
summary: Raleigh names Marius the Roman in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Marius the Roman, who ouerthrew the Cimbri when they descended into Italie. He is not Marius Niger. The one-word title would not say which man, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
